jobs_results.title: Mobile QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
⭐️ Role Overview

At Lodgify, we are looking for a talented QA Engineer (Mobile) to join our growing team. We are constantly working to improve our software and its features. A skilled QA Engineer will be not only a great contribution to that but also a key player for the QA team. You will apply your skills across the software development lifecycle to contribute to the ongoing success of the project.

⭐ How will you make an impact?

Test Planning and Execution:
• Develop test plans, test scenarios and test cases specifically for mobile applications
• Validate the functionality, usability, and consistency of mobile applications
• Designing automatable test cases and act as a bridge between Automation squad by ensuring testability and automatability

Cross-platform Testing

Defect Tracking, Reporting, Followup and Documentation:
• Document and track all identified bugs, inconsistencies and issues
• Collaborate with the development team to ensure timely resolution of issues

User... Experience Testing:
• Provide feedback on app design and functionality from the user’s perspective

Continuous Improvement:
• Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in mobile application testing
• Build a deep understanding of the Lodgify web and mobile platforms, as well as a strong intuition around our architecture and codebase to guide your sense for common issues that may arise

Quality Assurance Best Practices:
• Ensure software meets all requirements of quality including reliability, usability, and performance

Team Collaboration and Mentorship:
• Collaborate and work with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle
• Own communication throughout the sprint/release cycle, quality and delivery of the entire feature
• Coordinate testing effort with other team members and communicate adequately to the team about the test data needs.

⭐ What makes you a great fit?
• 1-2 year experience as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer
• Mobile application testing experience is a MUST
• Understand different types of mobile apps (native, Hybrid, web) and also different devices (iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS)
• Possess good exposure on Functional, Integration, Installation, Upgrade, Compatibility, GUI, Smoke, Ad hoc, and Regression testing. And also well versed with Persona-based testing
• Basic knowledge of API testing, Client-Server architecture, debugging, capturing and diagnosing server logs
• A self-starter who assumes responsibility for their work, accepts direction and feedback from co-workers and managers, and happily helps make anyone’s good idea a reality
• Demonstrate a strong sense of attention to detail in test execution and defect reporting
• Ability to speak, write and read technical documentation in English.

Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledges a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.

What's in it for you?

🏠 The freedom to work from home.

🌴 Enjoy 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August.

💊 Top-notch Cigna health insurance (includes travel insurance, dental plan, psychologist).

😋 Save on meals and transportation! Enjoy our Flexible Remuneration plan.

🖥️ Elevate your workspace. We provide a home-office setup allowance to ensure you have everything you need for a productive and comfortable work environment.

🎉 Travel to our biyearly team-building events in Barcelona at company's expense.

🇪🇸 Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Boost your earning potential with our referral program that offers paid compensation.

💟 Great culture & working environment with an international team of over 50 different nationalities.

So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Grafton es una multinacional dedicada a la captación de talento y a la búsqueda y selección de mandos intermedios y técnicos. Somos parte de Gi Group, una de las multinacionales de referencia ofreciendo soluciones personalizadas de Recursos Humanos.

Desde Grafton buscamos un programador QA Tester basado en la ciudad de Madrid para una compañía multinacional líder en su sector

Funciones
• Realización de pruebas manuales desde 0
• Recepción, gestión, resolución de incidencias y pruebas de software.
• Testear los desarrollos continuos de software.
• Revisar los resultados de las pruebas y coordinación de los posibles bugs o revisiones de los testeos asignados, durante todos los deploys en los distintos entornos hasta su puesta en producción.

Requisitos:
• Al menos de 3 a 5 años de experiencia profesional.
• Conocimiento de SQL
• Nivel de inglés fluido hablado y escrito
• Facilidad de aprendizaje, trabajo en equipo, búsqueda de nuevas soluciones e interés por la mejora continua.
• Se... valorará conocimientos en JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Katalon, Selenium y Jenkins, así como experiencia en automatización de pruebas
• FP Grado superior, licenciado o graduado con interés en el sector de la educación y las nuevas tecnologías

jobs_results.title: QA Sector Eléctrico
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

En Zemsania, estamos en la búsqueda de un/a Perfil de QA con experiência sólida entre 3 y 5 años en el sector eléctrico para un proyecto en Madrid. Trabajarás para uno de nuestros principales clientes, una empresa multinacional líder en el mercado con presencia en más de 50 países y operaciones en diversos sectores, incluyendo telecomunicaciones, banca, industria, administración pública y seguros.
• *¿Cuál será tu misión?**

Tu función principal será realizar Control de Calidad (QA) con enfoque en la automatización de portales para un cliente del sector eléctrico. Contarás con experiência específica en la utilización de Robot Framework.
• *¿Qué beneficios te ofrecemos?**
- Jornada intensiva los viernes y en julio y agosto.
- Flexibilidad horaria para lograr un equilibrio perfecto entre tu vida profesional y personal.
- Retribución flexible para que elijas los beneficios que mejor se adapten a tus necesidades (restaurante, guardería, transporte público, seguro... privado...).
- Salario competitivo, ajustado a tus competencias y experiência.
- Excelente ambiente de trabajo.
- Modalidad de trabajo presencial en Madrid.
- Estabilidad en una empresa con más de 20 años de trayectoria, colaborando con las principales empresas del sector.
- Trato cercano y seguimiento constante durante el proceso de selección.
- Acompañamiento personalizado con un People Partner y un Business Manager dedicados a tu desarrollo y bienestar.
• *Requisitos**:
• *¿Qué nos gustaría que aportaras al proyecto?**
- Experiência demostrable de 3 a 5 años en Control de Calidad (QA).
- Conocimientos del sector eléctrico.
- Experiência específica en la automatización de portales utilizando Robot Framework.
• *¿Te apasiona el mundo del Control de Calidad y la automatización de portales en el sector eléctrico? Esperamos conocerte pronto Inscríbete

jobs_results.title: Customer Service Fashion E-Commerce Italian Native Speaker
jobs_results.description:
The Spanish clothing brand is looking for an Italian customer service candidate. The eCommerce Online Sales Associate is accountable for providing the highest level of American customer care. This person will handle all aspects of order management, with a focus on providing sales and customer service to Italian customers via phone, email, and chat, WhatsApp. Note that our base customers will be B2B business, mostly boutiques that sell our brand.

Important:
• Italian Native Speaker Goals of the position:
• Maximize online sales and repeat customers through phone/email communication in Italy.
• Provide exceptional online customer service support
• Resolve order-related issues by liaising between client and internal/external groups (warehouse/carriers)
• Initiate and follow-up with new Italian customers
• Answer product-related and general inquiries
• Keep current with product information
• Assist with various operational and administrative tasks
• Support QA and share product and... website-related client feedback
• Contact clients for credit card decline and ensure daily sales goals are met
• Identify opportunities, seek new initiatives, and participate in the development of functional and service enhancements in order to maximize sales Knowledge:
• Fashion eCommerce sales and customer service experience
• Outstanding fashion selling behaviors, listening and responding to customer needs to deliver service
• Client-centric mentality
• Detail-oriented
• Positive can-do attitude
• Resourceful and creative problem solver
• Computer proficient (Microsoft Suite)
• Excellent written and verbal skills
• Drives to meet and exceed sales goals and customer expectations
• Team Player
• Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a dynamic environment Job Types: Full-time, Part-time Expected hours: 30 per week Work Location: In person

jobs_results.title: QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
At Omega CRM we believe that the quality of the project we develop is very important. Therefore, we would like for our QA team to keep growing:

Duties & Responsibilities

As a member of the QA team that we currently have in Omega, the main responsibilities in your day to day may be the following:
• Creation of test cases based on the analysis of documentation or business requirements, defining the results precisely without entering into ambiguities.
• Execution of test cases based on their design with a degree of quality and efficiency.
• Reporting errors by attaching all information clearly so that the developer has no doubts when resolving them.
• Basic knowledge in software development.
• Generating a progress report of tasks or areas of responsibility.
• Mastery of the use of established QA tools for the project/service.
• Acquiring and consolidating functional knowledge of the assigned project.
• Reporting on results.
• Detecting and communicating risks and/or problems that... arise in tasks. Supporting individuals with less experience.
• Building automated scripts for basic, low-complexity test cases.
• Monitoring resolved incidents and defects to verify their correction

REQUIREMENTS:
• Minimun 2 years in a similar role.
• Knowledge of/experience with test management tools. Provar is a plus
• Knowledge in Salesforce Projects
• Good communication and teamwork skills
• Knowledge/experience in defect manager tool (Jira).
• English level B2 or higher
• ISTQB certification

What Do We Offer
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office. You decide and we support you.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurtant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention
• Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go.

About Us

We are a digital global company whose mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, , #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 500 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Tester
jobs_results.description:
Description

Our Digital Engineering team at Storyteq are responsible for building world class, enterprise grade digital applications for high profile brands. We pride ourselves in working with mature Agile methodologies and make use of the latest versions of technology. Our teams are structured in such a way that gives every employee the opportunity to learn new skills, work on various projects over time and see the results of your efforts in the online consumer marketplace. Joining the Digital Engineering function would see you work as part of a cross-functional, product style team, generally consisting of a Business Analyst, Scrum Master / Project Manager, Solution Architect, Lead Developers (FE and BE), Developers, and Testers (Manual and Automated).

We are looking for a highly talented Automated Tester who is in search of every bug, defect and glitch in the matrix! You can perform functional and non-functional testing on web and mobile applications in your sleep. You'll need to... be confident in writing, programming, and running automated tests and regression suites; having gained demonstrable experience in Selenium WebDriver for automation and Automated API testing using RestAssured

Our Agile process is mature, and everyone can contribute when planning. We plan and estimate using Planning poker and the Fibonacci scale, ensuring that everyone in our team has a voice. Collaboration is key and we genuinely value everyone’s individual skillset and opinion.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work on cutting edge, enterprise grade web-based solutions, where you will be part of a brilliant cross functional team consisting of Developers, Business Analysts & Scrum Masters.

Personality is key and you need to fit the role as well as the team in equal measure. Storyteq prides itself on its culture and every new individual will need to be hard working, enthusiastic and willing to help.

Responsibilities:
• Creating, developing and improving the automation suites for projects
• Develop our automation tests within our test frameworks using Java as our core development language with selenium Web driver
• Working alongside Development teams and other stakeholders to resolve issues
• Writing and running test scripts and regression suits and accurately recording issues raised

Essential Skills
• You’re curious, ambitious, and hardworking and thrive in a fast-moving digital environment
• You already have experience in QA testing web-based applications, cross browser functional testing, strong familiarity with bug tracking and reporting applications, plus experience of writing test cases
• Needless to say, you will come armed with experience of Selenium WebDriver with the Java programming language HTML, CSS and JavaScript and a Working knowledge of BDD (Behaviour Driven Development.

Benefits

We Value Diversity!

We champion and welcome diversity in our workforce and ensure all job applicants receive equal and fair treatment, regardless of age, race, gender or gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or nationality.

We are not only committed to increasing the visibility and recognition of talent from under-represented groups within our organisation, but the wider industry too.

At the end of the day, we make sure we take time to look after ourselves, each other, and the planet, because we’re always stronger together.

ITG have a number of community groups (ERGs) available to employees which offer a safe space for like-minded colleagues, with shared interests to connect, socialise and check in with each other. These include Black ITGers Together, LGBTQ+ Together, Mens Health Together, Muslims Together, Neurodiversity Together, Working Parents and Carers Together and Women In Tech Together
